'''Magazine Warp''' is a [[mod]] that increases the [[magazine capacity]] of rifles.

==Stats==

==Drop Locations==
{{DropLocations}}

==Notes==
*For any non-integer magazine values the magazine size is simply rounded to the nearest whole number. For example, a {{Weapon|Braton}} modded with a max rank '''Magazine Warp''' will have a calculated magazine size of {{Math|45 {{mul}} (1 + 30%)|t=y|bf-a=y}}, which will simply round to '''59'''.
*Does not affect Incarnon mode. 

==Trivia==
*Prior to {{ver|16.7}}, this mod was usable in [[PvP]] games until it was replaced by its own specific PvP mods along with a number of other mods: {{M|Quickdraw}}, {{M|Fast Hands}}, {{M|Slip Magazine}}, {{M|Tactical Pump}}, {{M|Steady Hands}}, {{M|Stabilizer}}, {{M|Burdened Magazine}} and {{M|Terminal Velocity}}.
* Based on both {{WF|Loki}}'s leg pads and the direction the {{Weapon|Gorgon}} is pointing at, the image appears to be mirrored.

==Bugs==
*In {{ver|18.11}}, a max rank {{PAGENAME}} displayed +0.3% instead of +30% – the benefit remained the same.

{{ModBox}}
The '''Point Blank''' mod increases the base damage of a [[:Category:Shotgun|shotgun]] by 15% per rank at a maximum of 90% at rank 5.

==Stats==
===Normal===
{| class="emodtable"
|-

|-
| 2 || +30% || 4
|-
| 3 || +40% || 5
|}

==Drop Locations==
{{DropLocations}}

==Notes==
* Affects base damage which is applied before every other damage type. Therefore, every other damage increasing mod is benefiting from Point Blank as well.
**This mod combined with {{M|Vicious Spread}} and {{M|Blaze}} give off a total damage increase of +240%.
**With {{M|Primed Point Blank}} instead of '''Point Blank''', this adds up for a total damage increase of +315% with Vicious Spread and Blaze.
* Due to how it affects the base damage, this mod is necessary for all shotgun weapons in order to use them optimally. Few mods can replace the effectiveness of this mod.{{clr}}
